source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: A statement is a sentence that is either true (T) or false (F): «7 is prime» is T, «2 > 5» is F, while «x > 3» is not a statement.
stages.headlineEnglish: A statement is a sentence that is either true (T) or false (F): «7 is prime» is T, «2 > 5» is F, while «x > 3» is not a statement.

stages.headline: A ∨ B («or») is true if at least one is true, A ∧ B («and») if both are true, and ¬A has the opposite value of A.
stages.headlineEnglish: A ∨ B («or») is true if at least one is true, A ∧ B («and») if both are true, and ¬A has the opposite value of A.

stages.headline: Example: A = «6 is even» (T), B = «6 > 10» (F). Then A ∨ B is T, A ∧ B is F and ¬B is T.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: A = «6 is even» (T), B = «6 > 10» (F). Then A ∨ B is T, A ∧ B is F and ¬B is T.

stages.headline: A is true and B is false. What is A ∧ B?
stages.headlineEnglish: A is true and B is false. What is A ∧ B?

optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.

stages.headline: Is «3 > 5 or 4 < 7» true?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. «4 < 7» is true, so the disjunction is true.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. «4 < 7» is true, so the disjunction is true.

stages.headline: Negate «All squares are rectangles».
stages.correctAnswer: There is a square that is not a rectangle
stages.solutionSteps: 1. The negation of «all … are» is «some … is not».
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. The negation of «all … are» is «some … is not».
stages.customInstructions: Accept any correct wording of "there is a square that is not a rectangle".

stages.headline: A is false. What is ¬A ∨ B, whatever B is?
stages.headlineEnglish: A is false. What is ¬A ∨ B, whatever B is?
stages.problemText: A is false. What is ¬A ∨ B, whatever B is?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. ¬A is true, so the disjunction is true.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. ¬A is true, so the disjunction is true.
